entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Charlie. How can I help you today?
I need to return my VeloBand GPS Tracker.
I can certainly look into that for you. May I have your name and the email address associated with your VeloFit account?

Thank you, Alex. I'm pulling up your account now... Okay, I see your recent purchase of the VeloBand GPS Tracker. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with the device? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
It's just not what I wanted. It's really hard to use.
I'm sorry to hear that it's not meeting your expectations. Can you tell me a bit more about what you're finding difficult?
The whole menu system is confusing. I read the user manual, and it didn't help. Frankly, I expected more for the price.
I understand your frustration. Getting used to a new interface can be tricky. Well, let me just check the purchase date for you here... I see it was delivered 22 days ago.
Okay, one moment while I check our policy... Yes, it looks like you are well within the 90-day return window. I can go ahead and process that return for you immediately.
Great. So I can finally get this paperweight off my desk.

Yes, absolutely. I'm generating a prepaid return label that will be sent to your email on file. And Alex, I see you're one of our VIP members. For the trouble you've had, I'd also like to add a $25 credit to your account for a future purchase.

I've just sent it. It should be in your inbox within the next 5 minutes. Once we receive the device, you'll see a full refund to your original payment method within 3-5 business days. Is there anything else I can assist you with?
Not unless you can get my last three weeks back. No, that's it.
Alright. Well, thank you for calling VeloFit, and I hope you have a better day.
